mission: Close or materially reduce all current FAE proof gaps using CFBE best-of-breed benchmarking, reuse-first architecture, provider-native proof and measured value.

benchmark_patterns.github: active ruleset + PR-only + required checks + signed commits + linear history + merge queue/merge_group
benchmark_patterns.wif: GitHub OIDC ambient identity + attribute conditions + dedicated provider/pool trust domain + dedicated least-privilege service account
benchmark_patterns.apps_script: projects+versions+deployments+processes+scripts.run provider readback with user OAuth API-executable binding
benchmark_patterns.runtime: Cloud Run zero-traffic/tagged canary + readiness/health + gradual rollout + rollback
benchmark_patterns.state: transactional restart-safe state + CAS/fencing + append-only event history + rebuildable projections
benchmark_patterns.telemetry: OpenTelemetry-compatible traces/metrics/logs/resources + GenAI attributes + SLI/SLO/value metrics
benchmark_patterns.self_hosted_models: managed Cloud Run GPU + vLLM first; Kubernetes/KServe only after measured scale justifies operational complexity

truth_boundary: This source record does not activate GitHub rulesets, IAM/WIF, Apps Script deployments, Cloud Run services, GPUs, traffic, secrets, payments, publication or production effects. Those require target-specific authority and provider readback.
